overview.description: The State Street SPDR UC Investments 90/10 Endowment Strategy Index ETF (UCBG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target risk asset allocation. The State Street SPDR UC Investments 90/10 Endowment Strategy Index ETF (the Fund) seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond generally to the total return performance of an index. UCBG was launched on Sep 1, 2026 and is issued by State Street.
